warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the canonical Poisson-bracket model with a gravitational Hamiltonian in polar geometry, absorbing boundaries and the `M1_from_H` moment. In `rt_can_pb_newtonian_orbits_2x2v_p2.c`, `vt` (line 81) is the thermal velocity of the initial orbiting distribution; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong Hamiltonian gradient, a wrong polar metric or a wrong absorbing boundary changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-11, rtol=1e-11 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 2.3e-5 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 8.9e-6 (worst files `neut-imom.gkyl` and `neut-imom.gkyl`), a headroom of about 43130x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
